text:
sophie: quick async check — can folks drop the short status/ETA/blockers for Dedicated GPU buildout today? procurement, rack power, firmware, reservations, canary timeline. I'll take notes.

maria: procurement update — vendor pushed H100 shipment from 3/22 -> 3/25, tracking number updated. awaiting customs docs from vendor (they promised them by EOD). no impact to staging schedule yet but we lose 2 days buffer. :frown:

alex: reservations: capacity request PR #528 merged, quota allocated for initial canary (4 GPUs). I filed reservation ticket RES-3421 for the full closed-beta pool; ops needs to ack. link: https://internal.redwood/RES-3421

juan: infra note — power tests scheduled tomorrow 14:00 PT in staging racks 7/8. need ops on standby for breaker toggles. expected duration ~45m. I also have the short checklist: `check PDU mapping -> measure idle draw -> ramp test at 50%/100%`

maria: firmware: vendor sent BMC firmware v2.1.3 which addresses idle-cooling bug. ops requested a validation window before rolling to prod. suggestion: validate on 1 rack in staging during power test.

alex: canary schedule — aiming to run canary next Thu (3/26) if procurement confirms arrival. deploy-bot created the pipeline but it's paused until Reservation is confirmed and power tests pass.

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline `canary/dedicated-h100/03-26` created (id: pipe-8802). Status: PAUSED -> awaiting RES-3421 and staging-power-ok.

maria: blocker: customs docs needed -> Ops/Logistics (cc @ops-team) to confirm file delivery. vendor says digital signed docs by EOD, but if delayed we may shift canary to 3/29.

juan: small ask — can someone from platform run a dry-run of admission controller config that's going to gate reserved capacity? last time a misconfig dropped requests during overload. snippet of the test I used: ```
# simulate 10 concurrent reservations
for i in {1..10}; do rw capacity reserve --pool=dedicated-h100 --count=1 &
done
```

alex: I can run it after lunch. tagging @sophie to confirm test window (approx 12:30 PT).

sophie: thanks — action list I'm capturing: 1) @maria confirm customs docs by EOD (if not, propose 3/29 canary) 2) @juan run staging power test tomorrow 14:00 PT (ops standby) 3) @alex run admission-controller dry-run 12:30 PT and confirm RES-3421 reservation works 4) deploy-bot remains paused until items 1-3 complete. I'll post a short status in #eng-platform once we have results. :thumbsup:

maria: acked. I'll post vendor doc once received.

alex: ack, will run dry-run and ping here.

juan: ack, ops looped in on the power window.

sophie: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll update the runway spreadsheet and call out any schedule changes. (If anyone hits a blocker, drop a message here rather than a DM so we keep the thread as single source.)
